objectives.statement: Understand foundational mental models and architecture of TypeScript
Implement secure, reproducible solutions across real-world TypeScript tasks
Diagnose common production edge cases, bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities in TypeScript
Architect scalable enterprise workflows aligned with TypeScript industry best practices

prerequisites: Proficiency in modern JavaScript (ES6+ syntax, functions, objects, promises)
Familiarity with Node.js and package managers (npm or pnpm)

modules.title: Module 1: Structural Typing, Inference & Discriminated Unions
modules.summary: Understand the TypeScript compiler pipeline, type erasure, structural duck typing, type inference, narrowing, and discriminated unions.
lessonTitles: TypeScript Architecture, Type Erasure & Structural Typing
modules.checkpoint: Design discriminated union state machines with exhaustive compile-time never checking.

modules.title: Module 2: Generic Engineering & Type Transformation
modules.summary: Understand type parameters, generic constraints (extends), mapped types, the keyof operator, and core utility types (Partial, Pick, Omit, Record).
lessonTitles: Mapped Types, Keyof & Essential Utility Types
modules.checkpoint: Build reusable type-safe repositories using generics and mapped utility transformations.

modules.title: Module 3: Advanced Type Programming & Strict Production Systems
modules.summary: Understand conditional types, the infer keyword, template literal types, branded nominal types, strict tsconfig flags, and Zod runtime boundaries.
lessonTitles: Conditional Types, Infer Keyword & Template Literal Types
Strict Compiler Flags, Branded Types & Runtime Boundary Validation
modules.checkpoint: Implement conditional type extractors, branded nominal IDs, and runtime Zod validation boundaries.

practiceActivities: Configure a strict production tsconfig.json enforcing noUncheckedIndexedAccess and exactOptionalPropertyTypes
Model complex domain state machines using discriminated unions and exhaustive never checking
Author reusable generic higher-order functions with keyof and Record mapped types
Implement nominal branded types and runtime boundary schema validation with Zod
assessmentCheckpoints: Module 1: Structural Typing, Inference & Discriminated Unions Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 2: Generic Engineering & Type Transformation Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 3: Advanced Type Programming & Strict Production Systems Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
projects: Enterprise Type-Safe REST & GraphQL Gateway with Automated Type-Level Testing
proficiencyCriteria: Explain type erasure and differentiate structural typing (duck typing) from nominal type systems (Java/C#)
Execute type narrowing using type predicates (is), discriminated unions, and exhaustive switch checks
Design generic abstractions constrained by extends and infer keywords without using 'any'
Bridge runtime validation and compile-time typing using branded types and Zod schemas
